column3: SELECT net.http_post( url := e.url, headers := jsonb_build_object( 'Content-Type', 'application/json', 'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || k.key ), body := '{}'::jsonb ) FROM trip_private.cron_endpoints e JOIN trip_private.cron_keys k ON k.name = e.name WHERE e.name = 'purge_photos';

SELECT net.http_post( url := e.url, headers := jsonb_build_object( 'Content-Type', 'application/json', 'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || k.key ), body := '{}'::jsonb ) FROM trip_private.cron_endpoints e JOIN trip_private.cron_keys k ON k.name = e.name WHERE e.name = 'notify' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.notification_queue q WHERE q.status = 'queued' AND q.send_after <= now());
